mapper.select: SELECT id, initiation_id, wbs_task_id, period, pv, ev, ac, bac, cpi, spi, cv, sv, eac, vac, etc, tcpi, alert_level, alert_reason, measure_date, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_evm_measure WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY period DESC, wbs_task_id ASC

SELECT id, initiation_id, wbs_task_id, period, pv, ev, ac, bac, cpi, spi, cv, sv, eac, vac, etc, tcpi, alert_level, alert_reason, measure_date, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_evm_measure WHERE wbs_task_id = #{wbsTaskId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY period DESC

SELECT period, AVG(cpi) AS avg_cpi, AVG(spi) AS avg_spi, SUM(CV) AS sum_cv, SUM(SV) AS sum_sv, SUM(vac) AS sum_vac, SUM(eac) AS sum_eac, MAX(alert_level) AS top_alert FROM pmis_evm_measure WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY period ORDER BY period ASC

SELECT initiation_id, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE alert_level WHEN 'RED' THEN 3 WHEN 'YELLOW' THEN 2 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3 THEN 'RED' WHEN MAX(CASE alert_level WHEN 'RED' THEN 3 WHEN 'YELLOW' THEN 2 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 2 THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS top_alert FROM pmis_evm_measure WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY initiation_id
